title: WPSS/101/2018 of Dhanveer Shah AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 101 of 2018 (S/S)

Dhanveer Shah & Others Ö Petitioners
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & Others Ö Respondents
Sri B.P.S. Mer, Advocate, for the petitioners.
Sri M.C. Tiwari, Deputy Advocate General, assisted by Mr. Anil
Dabral, Brief Holder for the S e tate/r spondents.

By means of present writ petition, the
petitioners seek following prayer:
ìA writ, order or direction in the nature
of mandamus directing the respondent
no. 2 to give benefit of judgment dated
03.05.2017 passed in writ petition no.
92 of 2017 (S/S) (Neeraj Kumar Joshi
and others vs. State) (Annexure-4) and
writ petition no. 3713 of 2017 (Sri
Panchm Singh Mewari and Others vs.
State of Uttarakhand through Principal
Secretary, School Education & Others)
(Annexure No. 8 to the writ petition) and
accordingly consider them in the
counseling after giving them weightage
of their M.Sc. degreeî
Learned counsel for the petitioners drew
attention of this Court towards an order dated
03.05.2017, passed by a Coordinate Bench of this
Court in Writ Petition (S/S) No. 92 of 2017, which
has been followed by another coordinate Bench in
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 3713 of 2017, and prayed
that the petitioners be given the similar relief in
the present writ petition.
 For the sake of convenience, the order dated
03.05.2017 is being reproduced as under:

2
ìThe petitioners are working as
Assistant Teacher, L.T. Grade. The post
of Assistant Teacher, L.T. Grade is in
feeder category for promotion to the post
of Lecturer. The petitioners participated
in the selection process after obtaining
NOCs from the concerned authorities.
The candidature of the petitioners was
rejected on the ground that the degree
of M.Sc. obtained by them were from St.
Peterís Institute of Higher Education
and Research, J.R.N. Rajasthan
Vidyapeeth (Deemed to be) University
Udaipur (Rajasthan) and Open Distance
Education from Open University
Vinayak were not duly recognized. A
reference has been made to the Circular
in the month of June, 2013, 06.11.2015
and 08.12.2015. The petitioners have
given instances of the teachers who
have been promoted to the post of
Lecturer and who have also obtained
their respective M.Sc. Degrees from the
St. Peterís Institute of Higher Education
and Research, J.R.N. Rajasthan
Vidyapeeth (Deemed to be) University
Udaipur (Rajasthan) and Open Distance
Education from Open University
Vinayak were not duly recognized
through distant education mode. It is
also the case of the petitioners that the
juniors to them, who have obtained
Degree from the same Universities have
been promoted to the post of Lecturer.
The petitioners have obtained their
M.Sc. before the guidelines were issued
by the University Grants Commission.
Thus, the petitioners are also liable to
be considered for promotion to the post
of Lecturer on the basis of their M.Sc.
qualification before the issuance of
guidelines in the month of June, 2013,
06.11.2015 and 08.12.2015.
Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed.
Impugned order dated 02.07.2016 is
quashed and set aside. The respondents
are directed to consider the case of the
petitioners for promotion to the post of
Lecturer in the subject of Physics on the
basis of their M.Sc. obtained by them
before the guidelines issued by the

3
University Grants Commission within a
period of ten weeks from today. The
petitioners shall also be considered for
promotion from the date when his
juniors were promoted. Pending
application, if any, stands disposed of
accordingly.î
Learned counsel for the State-respondents
fairly conceded that the controversy involved in the
present writ petition is squarely covered by the
aforesaid decision of the Coordinate Bench of this
Court.
Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed. The
respondents are directed to consider the case of the
petitioners for promotion to the post of Lecturer in their
subjects on the basis of their M.Sc. degree obtained by
them before the guidelines issued by the University
Grants Commission within a period of ten weeks from
today. The petitioners shall also be considered for
promotion from the date when their juniors were
promoted.
 Registry is directed to issue certified copy of
this order to learned Counsel for the petitioners, within
24 hours, on his expenses.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
 11.01.2018
Prabodh
